lampLight.note: Babylon intensity is an initial calibration suggestion, not Cycles watts

environment.background: real static depth geometry, no image plate

water.reflection_membership: all visible foreground roles; no furniture baked into permanent reflection

texture_provenance.creator: Original analytical material authoring for Fading living scene
texture_provenance.source: Seeded periodic fields, woven height profiles, directional grain and cellular fissures; no acquired imagery
texture_provenance.method: Procedural detail baked to portable PNG maps; not scanned materials
texture_provenance.license: Project-authored original assets; no third-party asset license requirements
texture_provenance.normal_convention: Tangent-space OpenGL/glTF +Y; RGB encodes signed XYZ in [0,1]
texture_provenance.uv: Tileable [0,1] UV; no Blender-only texture transforms

brass.description: Weathered satin brass: subdued green-brown oxidation islands and fine directional brushing

wood.description: Worn dark walnut family: directional grain along V, soft satin wear and recessed pores

linen.description: Woven ivory flax with soft yarn crossings; broad physical folds supplied by mesh

cloth.description: Woven ivory flax with soft yarn crossings; broad physical folds supplied by mesh

porcelain.description: Warm white glossy porcelain with sparse original cobalt floral sprigs and a separate blue material for rim decoration

blue.description: Muted cobalt underglaze blue for porcelain decoration

rock.description: Wet dark slate with soft mineral layers, fissures and varied water-polished roughness

cliff.description: Cool stratified distant stone, matte mineral layers and subtle cellular fissures
